title: Remediate the ~/.claude agent architecture per SPEC revision 2

completion_criteria.text: The agent roster is exactly five: code-reviewer, security-reviewer, conformance-auditor, researcher, machinist
completion_criteria.check: ls ~/.claude/agents/*.md | wc -l returns 5, and the five basenames match that list

completion_criteria.text: No file in ~/.claude asserts what Claude Code can or cannot do
completion_criteria.check: grep -rniE 'harness property|is not supported|you cannot wait|children die|does not survive' ~/.claude/rules ~/.claude/agents ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md | wc -l returns 0

completion_criteria.text: Every retained agent carries a maxTurns circuit breaker set to the measured value in SPEC section 3.5
The always-on preamble sent verbatim to every cold subagent is under 13,000 bytes
No skill named in any agent's skills: field sets disable-model-invocation true, which would silently block preloading
completion_criteria.check: for every name in a skills: frontmatter field, grep -c 'disable-model-invocation: *true' on that skill's SKILL.md returns 0

completion_criteria.text: The hold-loop hook denies a Bash command containing sleep inside a loop
completion_criteria.check: Bash running i=0; until [ $i -ge 3 ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done is denied by PreToolUse with the stated reason

completion_criteria.text: The task-output hook denies reading a task output file
completion_criteria.check: Read on any path matching /tasks/[^/]*\.output$ is denied by PreToolUse

completion_criteria.text: Subagent nesting is structurally impossible: a dispatched agent cannot dispatch a child of its own
completion_criteria.check: dispatch an agent instructed to dispatch a child; no meta.json with spawnDepth 2 appears in the session subagents directory

completion_criteria.text: Each agent's first output field is its entry invariant, asserted with a command and its exit code
completion_criteria.check: grep -c '1. Entry invariant' on each file in ~/.claude/agents/ returns 1

completion_criteria.text: An agent whose entry invariant fails halts instead of proceeding on a wrong dispatch
completion_criteria.check: dispatch code-reviewer against a branch with an empty diff; it halts naming the empty diff and returns no review

completion_criteria.text: Two machinist agents dispatched concurrently work in separate worktrees without colliding on the git index
completion_criteria.check: dispatch two machinist agents at once; two distinct worktree paths appear and no index.lock error occurs

completion_criteria.text: Per-skill context cost is measured before and after the change, so the preamble claim is evidenced rather than asserted
completion_criteria.check: /skill-doctor report captured at both points and both stored on this thread

spine.active_goal: Produce an implementation plan from SPEC revision 2, then apply it: cut the agent roster from 13 to 5, move procedure out of agent bodies into skills, replace prose rules with categorical hooks, and shrink the always-on preamble from ~12,935 to ~2,520 tokens. The SPEC is the source of truth and is a ceiling, not a floor: build what it specifies, report anything it gets wrong, and never invent scope it does not name.
spine.next_step: Copy SPEC-agent-architecture-remediation.md out of the session scratchpad into the repo before anything else, because the scratchpad is session-scoped and the file dies with the session that wrote it. Cut a branch (never commit to main), land the SPEC under docs/, then write the implementation plan following SPEC section 9's ten-step order without reordering it.

key_decisions.title: Invert the delegation default: main works, delegation is the exception
Cut the roster from 13 to 5; collapse three maker personas into one machinist
A correctness gate asserts a categorical property; only a circuit breaker may carry a threshold
Replace the brief-length gate with per-agent entry invariants
Prohibit capability claims in configuration entirely
